revisionNote: Rev 3 adds a second check that reclassifies all six Test Solution 'gaps' as ANCHORING gaps: the behaviour was already covered, and covered more strongly than the producer requirement. Zero coverage gaps were found. Adds AIF-P1-010 (all requirements assert presence only). Rev 2 corrected the L5 cross-check for comma-separated multi-element anchors.

method.note: Link-by-link semantic screen. Java payload/serialization/mutation validators still blocked by the Maven outage.

L5_catalogCrosscheck.note: Multi-element anchors are split on ',' before lookup. An earlier pass used exact-string lookup and misreported DL1/157 as unmatched and 151/152 as matched.

testSolutionGapsFound.note: SECOND CHECK 2026-09-30 reclassified these. Reading full rule text, rather than element anchors alone, shows the behaviour is already covered. These are ANCHORING gaps, not coverage gaps. No producer requirement in this delivery identified behaviour the Test Solution was missing.

items.gap: sourceAnchor.element is empty on the existing framing rules, so element 24 is not machine-discoverable.
items.testSolutionIsStronger: Our rules pin the exact fixed marker per segment (DL2 '!', DL3 ':', DL4 '@', DL5 '$', DL6 '\'); the producer requirement asserts presence only.
items.action: Add element 24 to the existing rules. Do NOT add new rules.

items.gap: All 7 rules carry an empty element.
items.testSolutionIsStronger: R-003 makes Table 01 mandatory (implies EV Charging Data present); R-004 to R-007 cover sub-tables 02-12, formats and Visa enumerations.
items.action: Populate sourceAnchor.element, including 242. Do NOT add a presence rule.

items.gap: Rule catalogs encode multi-element anchors as a comma-separated string ('24,34').
items.action: Change element to an array and update canonical-anchor.schema.json.

testSolutionGapsFound.methodLesson: Element-anchor matching alone is not a coverage test: it cannot distinguish 'not covered' from 'covered but not anchored'. Rule text must be read before any gap is attributed to either producer.

secondCheck.question: Are the requirements the Test Solution appeared to miss genuinely missing, or was their absence deliberate or already covered under a different rule?
secondCheck.method: Read the full rule text, slugs, notes and KB field tables for every segment reported as unmatched, instead of comparing element anchors alone.

result.statement: Across all 37 full chains, no producer requirement identified ATL105 behaviour absent from the Test Solution catalogs. Where a match failed, the cause was missing element metadata on our side, not missing coverage.

correctionsToEarlierRevisions: Rev 1 attributed 8 unmatched chains to the AI; 2 were a matcher bug and 6 were ours.
Rev 2 called the 6 'catalog gaps'; they are anchoring gaps, and our coverage is stronger.
TT-0011 originally advised adding new rules; corrected to adding element metadata.

whatIsWorkingWell: All five legs delivered (BR/TS/TC/TD/mapping) - first delivery where the chain is traceable end to end.
Referential integrity is perfect: 0 unresolved TS->BR, 0 TC->TS, 0 TC without TD, 0 orphan TD.
29/37 anchor elements independently match a Test Solution rule catalog entry.
Real confidence scores (0.95) replace Run1's unscored_default=50 placeholder.
Filed as candidates with no self-asserted APPROVED state; Run1's no-op approval gate is gone.
12 gaps documented with specific, verifiable reasons rather than fabricated values.
oracle_authority is honestly labelled a confidence-gated proxy for SME approval.
Deterministic and reproducible: regenerating reproduces every file byte-for-byte.

findings.title: Composed test cases are not faithfully serialized into test data
findings.detail: 191 of 371 composed segments (51.5%) never appear in the wire message.

evidence.worstCase: TC-000010: 19 composed segments -> 10 in wire message

findings.impact: Test data does not represent the test case. Executing it would not exercise the intended requirement.

findings.title: Three test data files are empty but reported COMPLETE and PASS
findings.detail: TC-000008, TC-000017 and TC-000024 serialize to an empty object.
findings.impact: Producer self-verification does not detect empty output; PASS is not a quality signal.

findings.title: No test case carries a concrete expected response code
findings.impact: A test case with no expected outcome cannot pass or fail; these are request builders, not tests.

findings.title: Scenarios are verbatim copies of requirements
findings.detail: 37/37 scenario assertions are character-identical to the requirement statement, with parameters={} and target_transaction=null.
findings.impact: The scenario leg adds no test design; it is a relabelling, so BR->TS traceability is tautological.

findings.title: Every test case is a positive happy path
findings.impact: 'Field is required' is only proven by omitting the field. Requiredness is asserted, never tested.

findings.title: Segment names are renamed between test case and test data
findings.detail: Fleet Data Segment -> Fleet Segment (x19); Standard Message Data Segment -> Standard Segment; Variable Information Data Segment -> Variable Info Segment.
findings.impact: Automated link verification between TC and TD fails on name identity.

findings.title: No canonical source anchors on any leg
findings.detail: 0 of BR/TS/TC artifacts carry {specification, version, segment, rule}.
findings.impact: Anchor-based comparison cannot run; no coverage ratio is derivable.

findings.title: CONSTRAINT_NOT_VERIFIABLE advisories are raised inside a PASS verdict
findings.detail: 18 test cases report PASS while carrying UNRESOLVED_KB_GAP advisories.

evidence.example: Account Number (element 2) has no DEFINED length rule

findings.impact: PASS overstates confidence; advisories should downgrade the verdict.

findings.title: Two requirements carry no element association
findings.detail: Segments 151 and 152 ('Market Basket Data') have only ENT-SEG-* in related_entity_ids, no ENT-ELEM-*.
findings.impact: These two chains cannot be element-anchored against the Test Solution baseline.

findings.title: Every requirement asserts presence only; value constraints in the same spec row are dropped
findings.detail: All 47 requirements share one identical expected_behavior: 'is required and must be present'. All are requirement_type 'Field Validation' and derivation_method 'field_constraint'. No requirement carries a fixed value, enumeration, length or format constraint, even where the source row states one.

worked_example.aiRequirement: field 1 (Data Type Indicator) is required and must be present
worked_example.testSolutionRule: SEGDL2-R-001 pins Data Type Indicator fixed '!' (field 1)

findings.impact: The delivery exercises a single assertion shape. A test built from these requirements passes on any non-empty value, so it cannot detect a wrong marker, an out-of-range enumeration or a bad length. This is the root cause of the empty oracle in AIF-P1-003.
